# Runway

> Runway is a FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early) planner for iPhone and iPad. It turns a person's finances into one number, the age they could stop working, using their own country's real tax rules. Ten countries can be planned FROM, each on its own accounts, tax bands and pension rules: Norway (formuesskatt, the ASK account's capital-first withdrawals, the skjermingsfradrag, NAV and IPS pensions, and the utflyttingsskatt owed on leaving), Sweden, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, the Netherlands, the United States, Canada and Australia. It also prices retiring abroad: eighteen countries are modelled with 2026 figures and all of them work as destinations, plus a generic baseline for anywhere else, where the app says so up front and asks the user for a tax rate rather than assuming zero. Everything is computed on-device with no account and no bank logins. Made by Ludyem AS. On the App Store since August 25, 2026 in Norway, and worldwide (all 175 storefronts) since August 30, 2026.

Key facts:
- The freedom age and freedom number are free forever; Runway never paywalls "when can I stop working?". A Pro tier adds year-by-year depth, stress tests, scenario comparison, and solvers.
- Platform: iOS 26 or later, iPhone and iPad. English, Norwegian Bokmål, Italian, German and French.
- Privacy: no account, no bank connections; figures never leave the device.
- All figures are income-year-stamped estimates (2026) from public sources, not financial or tax advice.

## Original data
- [The Norway FIRE Index 2026](https://runwayfire.com/blog/norway-fire-index-2026/): representative households run through 2026 rules for Norway + 17 destinations. Key findings: at equal spending power, leaving Norway came out 1 to 3 years LATER everywhere (the ~2M kr exit tax eats the tax savings); a 100k kr/yr cheaper life abroad flips most destinations to 2 to 3 years earlier. Tables CC BY 4.0.

- [Folketrygden and FIRE](https://runwayfire.com/blog/state-pension-early-retirement-norway/): the pension bridge that shrinks your number
